01 · ABOUT ME

Hands-on experience.
Always learning.

I am Hamed Tajik, also known professionally as HT. My work sits at the intersection of electronics, software and digital creativity. I enjoy understanding how things work, diagnosing difficult problems and turning ideas into practical solutions.

My strongest technical background is in advanced mobile phone repair. With more than four years of hands-on experience, I focus on complex hardware troubleshooting, motherboard and board-level repair, component-level diagnosis and restoring devices that require careful technical analysis.

Alongside hardware, I have built experience in digital editing, application development and web development. I also study and work with financial markets, with an interest in trading, market behavior and disciplined risk management.
